focal_point: One white rounded card on a full-bleed hike. A single percent inside the card is the only punch.
eye_path: Diagonal from the trail into the card. The card is the end of the path.
grid: Two photo fields with one overlapping card. One intentional break: the card crosses the seam.
scale_ratios: The percent is larger than the sentence above it. About three sizes. This is the 1.6× idea in the wild.
type_choices: One sans in the card, three sizes, tiny mark elsewhere.
photo_art_direction: Bright hike, smiles at the lens, a product bottle in the same light. Coherent, slightly duplicated.
offer_placement: Center overlap, strong figure-ground. One qualifier under the percent, rightly small.
trust_and_cta: The retailer mark is small. This face does not say how to redeem. That is the only miss.
emulate: An overlapping white card on a full-bleed photo. The percent larger than its sentence. Then add one phone or one code in the card.
do_not_copy: The heart mark, the percent, the bottle, the photos.
anti_patterns: No redemption path on the face.
summary: Mailbox retail card. One of the three best-designed pieces in the whole set. A single card and a single percent. It stops short of an A only because the front never says how to redeem.
